purpose: Qwen3.8-27B SFT hyperparameter selection on fresh Fleet task outcomes

model.comparison: matched base versus one post-SFT checkpoint

checkpoint_binding_template.binding_rule: An arm-specific immutable child may fill every null exactly once, must reference this parent protocol SHA-256, and may not change any other field.
checkpoint_binding_template.acceptance_rule: Require accepted checkpoint seal, BF16 export and exact reload, create-once staging, serving registration, and live base/post parity before prepare.

sampling.seed_rule: attempt N uses base_seed + N - 1 modulo 2^31

valid_outcome_requires: exact frozen task, environment, starting-data and verifier bindings
normal terminal OpenCode event stream without an unfinished final step
challenge environment and all harness containers cleaned

primary.name: fleet_dev_paired_mean_success_delta_4fixed
primary.per_task_estimator: For each exact task version, average the four full-task solve indicators for the predeclared attempt seeds.
primary.arm_estimator: Mean the 20 per-task means with equal task weight.
primary.paired_comparison: Candidate minus base on each exact task-version and attempt-seed pair, then mean within task and across tasks.
primary.eligibility: All 80 task-seed pairs must contain authoritative valid outcomes for both base and candidate; no available fixed attempt may be discarded.

uncertainty.within_cluster: retain all four matched base/candidate seed pairs

metrics.invalid_outcome_policy: Never score infrastructure-invalid, interrupted, output-limited, or unknown attempts as model failures; the paired primary comparison remains incomplete.

selection_rule.task_weighting: equal task weight after averaging all four fixed attempts
selection_rule.ties: retain tied arms for a fresh predeclared confirmation

heldout_policy.external_benchmarks: run after each frozen checkpoint but keep sealed from HPO decisions

webexploitbench.unseal_only_after: the Fleet development selection decision is frozen

retry_policy.replacement_authority: none in this parent protocol; a separately reviewed symmetric amendment is required before any replacement execution
